items.title: SSH backend: 'no acceptable kex algorithm' against GSM7252PS with paramiko ≥ 3 (Debian ships 5.0; legacy-algorithm shim silently no-ops)
items.summary:
## Summary

The SSH CLI backend cannot connect to a GSM7252PS when the installed paramiko is ≥ 3. Every `backend="ssh"` call fails before auth:

```
SSH connect/auth failed: Incompatible ssh peer (no acceptable kex algorithm)
```

Because GSM7252PS/M4300 writes over SNMP `public` are read-only, this leaves the switch with **no working write path** through the library (e.g. `get_poe`/`clear_poe_fault`/`cycle_poe`/`set_pvid` with `backend="ssh"`).

## Environment

- `python3-netgear-switch-library
